pr.body:
## Review cleanup
- Removes the CONPORT_DB_PATH test path called out by Claude review and aligns the SQLite patch target with the current UI data-source module.
- Makes scripts/setup.sh check for dopemux-network before creating it, so unexpected Docker errors are not reported as success.

## Test Plan
- Validate Task Packet JSON and schema.
- Run shell syntax check on scripts/setup.sh.
- Run the targeted data source fallback test.
- Run git diff --check and pre-commit on changed files.
